titolo: Maple raises $5.3M to launch privacy‑first AI agent for desktop and cloud
descr: Maple secured $5.3 million seed funding to expand its encrypted AI assistant, now available on Mac, Windows and Linux.
paragrafi: The startup’s desktop app, Maple Work, lets the AI agent access files, apps and browsers while keeping all user data encrypted inside a trusted execution environment (TEE).

Maple runs a variety of open models—including DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Inkling, Google’s Gemma and OpenAI’s GPT OSS—inside the TEE, and the data is encrypted on the user’s device with a password only the user knows.
Future plans include a cloud‑based agent that can operate when the computer is offline, and an enterprise pilot offering zero‑data‑retention, with SOC 2 compliance in progress.
perche: For users, Maple promises AI productivity without exposing personal files to the service provider, appealing to privacy‑conscious individuals and businesses.
